import math
public import instance = "./instance.qui"

class Result(int[] starts, int decisions, int ties)

Result giffler_thompson(instance.Instance problem, string rule, int[] gene_positions := [])
    starts := array(#problem.operations, fill = 0)
    next_index := array(14, fill = 0)
    ready := array(14, fill = 0)
    free := array(nat(problem.machine_count), fill = 0)
    decisions := 0
    ties := 0
    for _ < int(#problem.operations)
        int[] candidates := []
        int[] earliest := []
        cutoff := 2147483647
        chosen_machine := 2147483647
        for job := problem.jobs[]
            if next_index[job.number] >= int(#job.operations)
                continue
            ident := job.operations[next_index[job.number]]
            operation := problem.operations[ident]
            start := math.max(ready[job.number], free[operation.machine - 1])
            completion := start + operation.duration
            candidates = candidates.append(ident)
            earliest = earliest.append(start)
            if completion < cutoff or (completion == cutoff and operation.machine < chosen_machine)
                cutoff = completion
                chosen_machine = operation.machine
        chosen := -1
        minimum := 2147483647
        conflict_count := 0
        minimum_count := 0
        for: position < int(#candidates)
            operation := problem.operations[candidates[position]]
            if operation.machine != chosen_machine or earliest[position] >= cutoff
                continue
            conflict_count += 1
            value := if rule == "SPT" then operation.duration elif rule == "LPT" then -operation.duration elif rule == "MWKR" then -operation.duration - operation.tail elif rule == "FIFO" then ready[operation.job] else gene_positions[operation.ident]
            if value < minimum
                minimum = value
                chosen = position
                minimum_count = 1
            elif value == minimum
                minimum_count += 1
        if conflict_count > 1
            decisions += 1
        if minimum_count > 1
            ties += 1
        selected := problem.operations[candidates[chosen]]
        starts[selected.ident] = earliest[chosen]
        ready[selected.job] = earliest[chosen] + selected.duration
        free[chosen_machine - 1] = earliest[chosen] + selected.duration
        next_index[selected.job] += 1
    return Result(starts, decisions, ties)

import math

class Scale(int quantum, int columns)
class Interval(int start, int finish, string mark)

Scale chart_scale(int makespan, int width)
    magnitude := 1
    steps := [1, 2, 5]
    index := 0
    quantum := 1
    columns := makespan
    while columns > width
        index += 1
        if index == 3
            index = 0
            magnitude *= 10
        quantum = steps[index] * magnitude
        columns = (makespan + quantum - 1) / quantum
    return Scale(quantum, columns)

string time_row(Scale scale)
    row := "time"
    for: 0 <= column < scale.columns step 10
        row += " " * nat(math.max(0, 6 + column - int(#row))) + "{column * scale.quantum}"
    return row

string rule_row(int columns)
    return "      " + [for column := (0:<columns)[] then if column % 10 == 0 then "+" else "-"].join("")

string framed(string label, string marks)
    return label + " " * nat(math.max(0, 4 - int(#label))) + " |" + marks + "|"

string chart_row(string label, Interval[] intervals, Scale scale)
    marks := ""
    for: column < scale.columns
        widest := 0
        earliest := 2147483647
        mark := "."
        for interval := intervals[]
            overlap := math.min(interval.finish, (column + 1) * scale.quantum) - math.max(interval.start, column * scale.quantum)
            if overlap > widest or (overlap == widest and overlap > 0 and interval.start < earliest)
                widest = overlap
                earliest = interval.start
                mark = interval.mark
        marks += mark
    return framed(label, marks)

string busy_row(Interval[][] machine_intervals, Scale scale)
    marks := ""
    for: column < scale.columns
        moment := column * scale.quantum
        busy := 0
        for intervals := machine_intervals[]
            for interval := intervals[]
                if interval.start <= moment < interval.finish
                    busy += 1
                    break
        marks += if busy == 10 then "X" else "{busy}"
    return framed("busy", marks)

import math
public import minstd = "./minstd.qui"

public import dispatch = "./dispatch_rules.qui"

int[] gene_operations(dispatch.instance.Instance problem, int[] chromosome)
    counts := array(14, fill = 0)
    int[] operations := []
    for gene := chromosome[]
        operations = operations.append(problem.job_ops[gene][counts[gene]])
        counts[gene] += 1
    return operations

int[] decode(dispatch.instance.Instance problem, int[] chromosome)
    starts := array(#problem.operations, fill = 0)
    ready := array(14, fill = 0)
    free := array(nat(problem.machine_count), fill = 0)
    for ident := gene_operations(problem, chromosome)[]
        operation := problem.operations[ident]
        start := math.max(ready[operation.job], free[operation.machine - 1])
        starts[ident] = start
        ready[operation.job] = start + operation.duration
        free[operation.machine - 1] = start + operation.duration
    return starts

int tournament(minstd.Minstd &rng, int[] values, int size)
    best := -1
    for _ < size
        index := .rng.below(int(#values))
        if best < 0 or values[index] < values[best] or (values[index] == values[best] and index < best)
            best = index
    return best

int[] preserve_order(int[] keeper, int[] donor, bool[] kept)
    fillers := [for gene := donor[] if not kept[gene] then gene]
    int[] child := []
    position := 0
    for gene := keeper[]
        if kept[gene]
            child = child.append(gene)
        else
            child = child.append(fillers[position])
            position += 1
    return child

class Children(int[] first, int[] second)

Children crossover(minstd.Minstd &rng, int[] first, int[] second, int[] jobs)
    kept := array(14, fill = false)
    for job := jobs[]
        if .rng.below(2) == 0
            kept[job] = true
    return Children(preserve_order(first, second, kept), preserve_order(second, first, kept))

void swap_mutation(minstd.Minstd &rng, int[] &chromosome)
    first := .rng.below(int(#chromosome))
    second := .rng.below(int(#chromosome))
    held := chromosome[first]
    chromosome[first] = chromosome[second]
    chromosome[second] = held

void insert_mutation(minstd.Minstd &rng, int[] &chromosome)
    source := .rng.below(int(#chromosome))
    target := .rng.below(int(#chromosome))
    held := chromosome[source]
    remaining := chromosome[0:<source].concat(chromosome[source + 1:])
    chromosome = remaining[0:<target].append(held).concat(remaining[target:])

import math

class Operation(int ident, int job, int index, int machine, int duration, int head, int tail, int job_prev, int job_next)
    code := "J{job}-{index}"

class Job(int number, int[] operations, int work)
class Machine(int number, int[] operations, int load, int head, int tail)
    bound := head + load + tail

class Instance(int machine_count, Job[] jobs, Operation[] operations, Machine[] machines, string[] errors)
    durations := [for operation := operations[] then operation.duration]
    int[][] job_ops := array(14, fill = [])
    for job := jobs[]
        job_ops[job.number] = job.operations

Instance load_instance(string path)
    content := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin(path))
    lines := content.split(NL)
    sizes := lines[0].split(" ")
    job_count := int(sizes[0])
    machine_count := int(sizes[1])
    Job[] jobs := []
    Operation[] operations := []
    string[] errors := []
    for: 1 <= number <= job_count
        tokens := lines[number].split(" ")
        int[] route := []
        int[] durations := []
        problem := ""
        for: index < int(#tokens)
            pair := tokens[index].split(":")
            machine := int(pair[0])
            duration := int(pair[1])
            if machine < 1 or machine > machine_count
                problem = "unknown machine {machine}"
            elif duration < 1 or duration > 99
                problem = "bad duration {duration}"
            else
                for earlier := route[]
                    if earlier == machine
                        problem = "repeated machine {machine}"
            if problem != ""
                errors = errors.append("job {number} operation {index + 1}: {problem}")
                break
            route = route.append(machine)
            durations = durations.append(duration)
        if problem != ""
            continue
        work := durations.sum()
        head := 0
        int[] identifiers := []
        for: index < int(#route)
            ident := int(#operations)
            previous := if index == 0 then -1 else ident - 1
            following := if index + 1 == int(#route) then -1 else ident + 1
            operations = operations.append(Operation(ident, number, index + 1, route[index], durations[index], head, work - head - durations[index], previous, following))
            identifiers = identifiers.append(ident)
            head += durations[index]
        jobs = jobs.append(Job(number, identifiers, work))
    Machine[] machines := []
    for: 1 <= number <= machine_count
        int[] identifiers := []
        load := 0
        min_head := 2147483647
        min_tail := 2147483647
        for operation := operations[]
            if operation.machine == number
                identifiers = identifiers.append(operation.ident)
                load += operation.duration
                min_head = math.min(min_head, operation.head)
                min_tail = math.min(min_tail, operation.tail)
        machines = machines.append(Machine(number, identifiers, load, min_head, min_tail))
    return Instance(machine_count, jobs, operations, machines, errors)

import math
import genetic = "./genetic.qui"
import gantt = "./gantt.qui"

string[] read_lines(string path)
    content := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin(path))
    lines := content.split(NL)
    return lines[0:<#lines - 1]

class Parameters(local string[][] rows)
    seed := int(rows[0][1])
    population := int(rows[1][1])
    generations := int(rows[2][1])
    tournament := int(rows[3][1])
    int[] crossover := [for part := rows[4][1].split("/")[] then int(part)]
    int[] swap := [for part := rows[5][1].split("/")[] then int(part)]
    int[] insert := [for part := rows[6][1].split("/")[] then int(part)]
    elitism := int(rows[7][1])
    int[] checkpoints := [for value := rows[8][1:][] then int(value)]
    tabu_iterations := int(rows[9][1])
    tabu_tenure := int(rows[10][1])
    gantt_width := int(rows[11][1])

string percentage(int part, int whole)
    tenths := (2000 * part + whole) / (2 * whole)
    return "{tenths / 10}.{tenths % 10}%"

string job_letter(int number)
    return "ABCDEFGHIJKLM"[number - 1]

string integers(int[] values)
    return [for value := values[] then "{value}"].join(" ")

int makespan_of(int[] starts, int[] durations)
    result := 0
    for: ident < int(#starts)
        result = math.max(result, starts[ident] + durations[ident])
    return result

int jackson_bound(genetic.dispatch.instance.Instance problem, genetic.dispatch.instance.Machine machine)
    remaining := [for ident := machine.operations[] then problem.operations[ident].duration]
    left := int(#remaining)
    moment := 0
    bound := 0
    while left > 0
        release := 2147483647
        for: position < int(#remaining)
            if remaining[position] > 0
                release = math.min(release, problem.operations[machine.operations[position]].head)
        moment = math.max(moment, release)
        chosen := -1
        for: position < int(#remaining)
            operation := problem.operations[machine.operations[position]]
            if remaining[position] == 0 or operation.head > moment
                continue
            if chosen < 0
                chosen = position
            else
                previous := problem.operations[machine.operations[chosen]]
                if operation.tail > previous.tail or (operation.tail == previous.tail and operation.job < previous.job)
                    chosen = position
        step := remaining[chosen]
        for ident := machine.operations[]
            head := problem.operations[ident].head
            if head > moment
                step = math.min(step, head - moment)
        moment += step
        remaining[chosen] -= step
        if remaining[chosen] == 0
            left -= 1
            bound = math.max(bound, moment + problem.operations[machine.operations[chosen]].tail)
    return bound

int[] order_starts(genetic.dispatch.instance.Instance problem, int[][] order, int[] durations)
    starts := array(#problem.operations, fill = -1)
    completions := array(#problem.operations, fill = 0)
    positions := array(nat(problem.machine_count), fill = 0)
    placed := 0
    while placed < int(#problem.operations)
        for: int machine < problem.machine_count
            sequence := order[machine]
            while positions[machine] < int(#sequence)
                position := positions[machine]
                ident := sequence[position]
                previous := problem.operations[ident].job_prev
                if previous >= 0 and starts[previous] < 0
                    break
                ready := if previous < 0 then 0 else completions[previous]
                free := if position == 0 then 0 else completions[sequence[position - 1]]
                starts[ident] = math.max(ready, free)
                completions[ident] = starts[ident] + durations[ident]
                positions[machine] += 1
                placed += 1
    return starts

class Move(int first, int second)
class LeftShift(bool possible, start := 0, position := 0)
class Slacks(int[] slack, int[] free)

class Schedule(genetic.dispatch.instance.Instance problem, int[] starts)
    int[] completions := [for ident := (0:<int(#starts))[] then starts[ident] + problem.durations[ident]]
    makespan := completions.max()
    int[][] order := array(nat(problem.machine_count), fill = [])
    machine_prev := array(#starts, fill = -1)
    machine_next := array(#starts, fill = -1)

    for ident := by_start()[]
        local machine := problem.operations[ident].machine - 1
        if #order[machine] > 0
            local previous := order[machine][-1]
            machine_prev[ident] = previous
            machine_next[previous] = ident
        order[machine] = order[machine].append(ident)

    int[] by_start()
        int[] result := []
        for: ident < int(#starts)
            position := int(#result)
            result = result.append(ident)
            while position > 0
                previous := result[position - 1]
                if starts[previous] < starts[ident] or (starts[previous] == starts[ident] and previous < ident)
                    break
                result[position] = previous
                position -= 1
            result[position] = ident
        return result

    int[] chromosome()
        return [for ident := by_start()[] then problem.operations[ident].job]

    int[] critical_path()
        current := 0
        while completions[current] != makespan
            current += 1
        int[] reverse := []
        while true
            reverse = reverse.append(current)
            if starts[current] == 0
                break
            previous := machine_prev[current]
            current = if previous >= 0 and completions[previous] == starts[current] then previous else problem.operations[current].job_prev
        return reverse[::-1]

    int[][] blocks(int[] path)
        int[][] result := []
        for ident := path[]
            last := int(#result) - 1
            if last >= 0 and problem.operations[result[last][-1]].machine == problem.operations[ident].machine
                result[last] = result[last].append(ident)
            else
                result = result.append([ident])
        return result

    Move[] moves()
        Move[] result := []
        for block := blocks(critical_path())[]
            for: 1 <= position < int(#block)
                result = result.append(Move(block[position - 1], block[position]))
        return result

    int path_count()
        ways := array(#starts, fill = 0)
        for ident := by_start()[]
            if starts[ident] == 0
                ways[ident] = 1
            else
                for previous := [problem.operations[ident].job_prev, machine_prev[ident]][]
                    if previous >= 0 and completions[previous] == starts[ident]
                        ways[ident] += ways[previous]
        count := 0
        for: ident < int(#starts)
            if completions[ident] == makespan
                count += ways[ident]
        return count

    LeftShift left_shift(int ident)
        operation := problem.operations[ident]
        sequence := order[operation.machine - 1]
        position := 0
        while sequence[position] != ident
            position += 1
        if position == 0
            return LeftShift(false)
        ready := if operation.job_prev < 0 then 0 else completions[operation.job_prev]
        for: insertion < position
            begin := if insertion == 0 then 0 else completions[sequence[insertion - 1]]
            start := math.max(begin, ready)
            if start + operation.duration <= starts[sequence[insertion]]
                return LeftShift(true, start, insertion)
        return LeftShift(false)

    int shiftable_count()
        count := 0
        for: ident < int(#starts)
            if left_shift(ident).possible
                count += 1
        return count

    Slacks slacks()
        latest := array(#starts, fill = 0)
        slack := array(#starts, fill = 0)
        free := array(#starts, fill = 0)
        for ident := by_start()[::-1][]
            latest_limit := makespan
            start_limit := makespan
            for following := [problem.operations[ident].job_next, machine_next[ident]][]
                if following >= 0
                    latest_limit = math.min(latest_limit, latest[following])
                    start_limit = math.min(start_limit, starts[following])
            latest[ident] = latest_limit - problem.durations[ident]
            slack[ident] = latest[ident] - starts[ident]
            free[ident] = start_limit - completions[ident]
        return Slacks(slack, free)

    int[] path_counts(int[] path)
        counts := array(nat(problem.machine_count), fill = 0)
        for ident := path[]
            counts[problem.operations[ident].machine - 1] += 1
        return counts

    int bottleneck(int[] path)
        counts := path_counts(path)
        best := 0
        for: 1 <= machine < int(#counts)
            if counts[machine] > counts[best]
                best = machine
        return best

    int flow()
        total := 0
        for job := problem.jobs[]
            total += completions[job.operations[-1]]
        return total

    int total_idle()
        int[] durations := problem.durations
        return makespan * problem.machine_count - durations.sum()

    string letters(int machine)
        return [for ident := order[machine][] then job_letter(problem.operations[ident].job)].join("")

Schedule schedule_of_order(genetic.dispatch.instance.Instance problem, int[][] order)
    return Schedule(problem, order_starts(problem, order, problem.durations))

int[][] apply_move(genetic.dispatch.instance.Instance problem, int[][] order, Move move)
    result := order
    machine := problem.operations[move.first].machine - 1
    position := 0
    while result[machine][position] != move.first
        position += 1
    result[machine][position] = move.second
    result[machine][position + 1] = move.first
    return result

int[] distances(Schedule first, Schedule second)
    int[] result := []
    for: int machine < first.problem.machine_count
        rank := array(#first.starts, fill = 0)
        for: position < int(#second.order[machine])
            rank[second.order[machine][position]] = position
        sequence := first.order[machine]
        count := 0
        for: low < int(#sequence)
            for: low + 1 <= high < int(#sequence)
                if rank[sequence[low]] > rank[sequence[high]]
                    count += 1
        result = result.append(count)
    return result

class TabuRecord(int iteration, int move_count, int tabu_count, Move move, bool aspiration, int value, int best)
class Search(int start_value, int[][] best_order, int best_value, int found, TabuRecord[] records, string reason)

Search tabu_search(genetic.dispatch.instance.Instance problem, int[][] order, Parameters params)
    start := schedule_of_order(problem, order).makespan
    current := order
    best_order := order
    best := start
    found := 0
    TabuRecord[] records := []
    reason := "limit"
    map<string, int> expiry
    for: 1 <= iteration <= params.tabu_iterations
        moves := schedule_of_order(problem, current).moves()
        if #moves == 0
            reason = "no_moves"
            break
        int[] values := []
        bool[] blocked := []
        chosen := -1
        tabu_count := 0
        for: position < int(#moves)
            move := moves[position]
            value := schedule_of_order(problem, apply_move(problem, current, move)).makespan
            values = values.append(value)
            end_iteration := 0
            match expiry.get("{move.first}:{move.second}")
                int limit
                    end_iteration = limit
                none
                    end_iteration = 0
            forbidden := end_iteration >= iteration
            blocked = blocked.append(forbidden)
            if forbidden
                tabu_count += 1
            if (not forbidden or value < best) and (chosen < 0 or value < values[chosen])
                chosen = position
        if chosen < 0
            reason = "all_tabu"
            break
        selected := moves[chosen]
        current = apply_move(problem, current, selected)
        .expiry.set("{selected.second}:{selected.first}", iteration + params.tabu_tenure)
        if values[chosen] < best
            best_order = current
            best = values[chosen]
            found = iteration
        records = records.append(TabuRecord(iteration, int(#moves), tabu_count, selected, blocked[chosen], values[chosen], best))
    return Search(start, best_order, best, found, records, reason)

class Shift(int ident, int old_start, int new_start)
class Activation(int[][] order, Shift[] shifts)

Activation activate(genetic.dispatch.instance.Instance problem, int[][] order)
    current := order
    Shift[] shifts := []
    while true
        schedule := schedule_of_order(problem, current)
        selected := -1
        target := LeftShift(false)
        for ident := schedule.by_start()[]
            candidate := schedule.left_shift(ident)
            if candidate.possible
                selected = ident
                target = candidate
                break
        if selected < 0
            break
        machine := problem.operations[selected].machine - 1
        remaining := [for ident := current[machine][] if ident != selected then ident]
        current[machine] = remaining[0:<target.position].append(selected).concat(remaining[target.position:])
        shifts = shifts.append(Shift(selected, schedule.starts[selected], target.start))

    return Activation(current, shifts)

int[] ranking(int[] values)
    int[] result := []
    for: index < int(#values)
        position := int(#result)
        result = result.append(index)
        while position > 0 and values[index] < values[result[position - 1]]
            result[position] = result[position - 1]
            position -= 1
        result[position] = index
    return result

int gcd(int first, int second)
    a := first
    b := second
    while b != 0
        a, b = b, a % b
    return a

class Record(int generation, int value, int individual)
class Counts()
    crossovers := 0
    swaps := 0
    inserts := 0

void mutate(genetic.minstd.Minstd &rng, int[] &child, Parameters params, Counts &counts)
    if .rng.chance(params.swap)
        counts.swaps += 1
        genetic.swap_mutation(&rng, &child)
    if .rng.chance(params.insert)
        counts.inserts += 1
        genetic.insert_mutation(&rng, &child)

class GeneticResult(int[][] population, int[] values, int[] ranked, Record[] records, string[] progress, Counts counts)

GeneticResult run_ga(genetic.dispatch.instance.Instance problem, Parameters params, Schedule[] baselines)
    rng := genetic.minstd.Minstd(params.seed)
    jobs := [for job := problem.jobs[] then job.number]
    int[] basic := []
    for job := problem.jobs[]
        for _ < int(#job.operations)
            basic = basic.append(job.number)
    population := [for schedule := baselines[] then schedule.chromosome()]
    while int(#population) < params.population
        chromosome := basic
        .rng.shuffle(&chromosome)
        population = population.append(chromosome)
    counts := Counts()
    Record[] records := []
    progress := ["generation,best,mean,worst,distinct"]
    previous_best := 2147483647
    int[] values := []
    int[] ranked := []
    for: 0 <= int generation <= params.generations
        values = [for chromosome := population[] then makespan_of(genetic.decode(problem, chromosome), problem.durations)]
        ranked = ranking(values)
        best := ranked[0]
        if values[best] < previous_best
            records = records.append(Record(generation, values[best], best + 1))
        previous_best = values[best]
        for checkpoint := params.checkpoints[]
            if checkpoint != generation
                continue
            distinct<string> seen
            for chromosome := population[]
                .seen.add(integers(chromosome))
            total := values.sum()
            divisor := gcd(total, int(#values))
            progress = progress.append("{generation},{values[best]},{total / divisor}/{int(#values) / divisor},{values[ranked[-1]]},{seen.size()}")
        if generation == params.generations
            break
        offspring := [for index := ranked[0:<params.elitism][] then population[index]]
        for _ < (params.population - params.elitism) / 2
            first_index := genetic.tournament(&rng, values, params.tournament)
            second_index := genetic.tournament(&rng, values, params.tournament)
            first := population[first_index]
            second := population[second_index]
            if .rng.chance(params.crossover)
                counts.crossovers += 1
                children := genetic.crossover(&rng, first, second, jobs)
                first = children.first
                second = children.second
            mutate(&rng, &first, params, &counts)
            mutate(&rng, &second, params, &counts)
            offspring = offspring.append(first).append(second)
        population = offspring
    return GeneticResult(population, values, ranked, records, progress, counts)

void write_lines(string name, string[] lines)
    writer1 := file.write("output/" + name)
    .writer1(lines.join(NL) + NL)

problem := genetic.dispatch.instance.load_instance("input/instance.txt")
params := Parameters([for row := read_lines("input/ga_params.txt")[] then row.split(" ")])
rules := ["SPT", "LPT", "MWKR", "FIFO"]
jacksons := [for machine := problem.machines[] then jackson_bound(problem, machine)]
job_bound := 0
for: 1 <= index < int(#problem.jobs)
    if problem.jobs[index].work > problem.jobs[job_bound].work
        job_bound = index
machine_bound := 0
jackson_machine := 0
for: 1 <= int machine < problem.machine_count
    if problem.machines[machine].bound > problem.machines[machine_bound].bound
        machine_bound = machine
    if jacksons[machine] > jacksons[jackson_machine]

class Minstd(int state)
    int .draw()
        state = 48271 * state % 2147483647
        return state

    int .below(int limit)
        return .draw() % limit

    bool .chance(int[] probability)
        return .draw() % probability[1] < probability[0]

    void .shuffle(int[] &items)
        size := int(#items)
        while size > 1
            index := .below(size)
            held := items[size - 1]
            items[size - 1] = items[index]
            items[index] = held
            size -= 1
